svg.text: Deterministic metrics for the Dashboard's spending pace, the Reports tab and the Financial Summary facts. No LLM. Stateless: it reads Ledger-owned reporting views and stores nothing.
facts payload · one route per section
user context from the signed request
Section engine: every request runs 1 → 6 · one registry of read-only functions (ctx, period) → section
Dashboard: spending pace (this month to date vs same days last month)
Reports: income vs expenses by month · category breakdown vs prior
period · category trends by month · top merchants
Facts: cash flow · categories · budgets · anomalies & new merchants
fees · free-trial conversion · duplicate charges · small-purchase leakage
each emits scored candidates with computed impact
a failing detector is skipped and listed; top 8 → insight_candidates
same views feed its Dashboard totals
read-only role · SELECT on the views only
Stateless: no tables, no cache, no events consumed or published, no scheduled jobs; nothing to delete on account closure.
